executiveSummary: Overall OT Threat Level: HIGH Multiple U.S. government advisories confirm active exploitation against internet-exposed PLCs in U.S. critical infrastructure, including logic tampering impacting operations in Water/Wastewater and Energy sectors. Immediate removal from internet exposure and integrity checks are advised. CISA Advisory A separate joint advisory highlights an ongoing, AI-assisted threat to Siemens S7 PLCs (S7comm/TCP-102) seeking to read/write memory and mimic monitoring tools; defenders should disable PUT/GET where possible and deploy S7-aware detections. CISA Advisory Edge device compromise risk elevated: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) CVSS 10 auth-bypass is being exploited in the wild to gain root, steal configs/credentials, and deploy ransomware; patch immediately and remove FMC from internet exposure. View Article MikroTik RouterOS zero/auth-bypass chains are under active exploitation with concrete IoCs and persistence; immediate upgrade, compromise assessment, and credential rotation are required. CERT Polska Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway pre-auth RCE (CVE-2026-8452) in SAML mode with public PoC presents immediate perimeter risk and potential OT pivot; patch or restrict exposure now. JPCERT/CC Alert Supply chain exposure rising: GitLab CVSS 10 file-read (CVE-2026-85706) is under active probing, enabling theft of CI/CD tokens and secrets; restrict exposure and rotate credentials post-patch. View Article JFrog Artifactory vulnerabilities are being chained to gain admin control and plant backdoors, threatening downstream software integrity used in CI and OT gateways. View Article Core OT protocols/components: Multiple Eclipse Milo (OPC UA) server flaws could enable credential recovery, authorization bypass, and DoS across ICS environments. CISA Bulletin SCADA/HMI exposure: PcVue credential weaknesses prior to v17.0.0 can aid privilege escalation on HMI servers-prioritize upgrades and protect project directories. CISA Bulletin KEV expansions add active exploitation for Fortinet, Citrix NetScaler, Google V8, and Cisco FMC-accelerate remediation on exposed assets and verify for pre-patch compromise. CISA KEV Update Bottom line: The combination of confirmed PLC targeting, multiple exploited perimeter/management-plane devices, and active supply-chain abuse raises near-term risk of OT-impacting incidents. Prioritize edge hardening, rapid patching, and protocol-aware monitoring across IT/OT boundaries.

relevance: The week's intelligence shows concurrent pressure on: (1) field controllers (PLCs) via direct exposure and weak access controls, (2) protocol stacks (OPC UA, S7comm) enabling loss of view/control, and (3) the IT edge/management plane (VPN/firewall/routers, CI systems) that bridges IT to OT. Supply-chain compromises of GitLab/Artifactory can poison engineering tools or gateway components. Net effect: elevated probability of IT-to-OT pivot and process impact, especially for water, power, and manufacturing.

descriptions: Initial Access: Exploitation of public-facing edge (Cisco FMC, NetScaler), router compromise (MikroTik), exposed VNC/HMI; Supply-chain (GitLab/Artifactory).
Execution: Web shells/JSP/JAR loaders; policy tampering and LoTL via management consoles; PLC program writes (S7comm PUT/GET; Modbus writes).
Privilege Escalation/Lateral Movement: Impacket (psexec/secretsdump), token abuse, router pivot, management-plane to OT jump hosts.
Defense Evasion: Living-off-the-land within FMC; custom webshell paths (/var/vpn/theme/); router persistence (scheduler/scripts).
Exfiltration: M365 OneDrive/SharePoint to Mega; router tunneling; covert infra via compromised SOHO/IoT.
Impact: HMI alarm suppression, setpoint changes, PLC logic tampering; potential availability loss (OPC UA/DoS).

outlook72h: Patch & contain: Cisco FMC, NetScaler ADC/Gateway (SAML), MikroTik RouterOS, GitLab, JFrog Artifactory on internet-facing or shared-service systems. Hunt operations: Check NetScaler /var/vpn/theme/ for webshells; Cisco FMC web logs for anomalous tasks/users; MikroTik for new users/scheduler; GitLab API access to commits API with suspicious parameters; Artifactory for rogue plugins/tokens. OT safeguards: Disable PLC internet exposure; set Siemens S7 protection levels; verify logic integrity and alarm configurations; deploy protocol-aware (S7/OPC UA/Modbus) detections on jump hosts and DMZs. Credential hygiene: Rotate admin creds/tokens across edge and CI/CD platforms; invalidate sessions; enforce phishing-resistant MFA. KEV tracking: Align remediation with KEV timelines; perform pre-/post-patch compromise assessments on listed assets.
